MINUTES
  MALIBU PLANNING COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  DECEMBER 4, 2023
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS AND TELECONFERENCED
  6:30 P.M.

The following meeting was held in a hybrid format that allowed members of the public to
participate in-person and remotely via Zoom.

CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Hill called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Kraig Hill, Vice Chair John G. Mazza, Commissioners Drew Leonard,
  Skylar Peak, and Dennis R. Smith

  ALSO PRESENT: Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney; Richard Mollica, Planning
  Director; Raneika Brooks, Senior Planner; Tyler Eaton, Senior Planner; Fletcher Allen,
  Assistant Planner; Alexander da Silva, Assistant Planner; Parker Davis, Media Technician;
  and Rebecca Evans, Recording Secretary

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Don Schmitz led the Pledge of Allegiance.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Vice Chair Mazza moved and Chair Hill seconded a motion to approve the agenda
  as recommended by staff, continuing Item No. 4.A. to a date uncertain and Item
  No. 5.A. to the January 16, 2024 Regular Planning Commission meeting.

  The question was called and the motion carried unanimously.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Recording Secretary Evans reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted
  on November 22, 2023. The amended agenda was properly posted on November 29. 2023.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS
  None.
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes of December 4, 2023
  Page 2 of 8

ITEM 2.A.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Jo Drummond expressed disappointment that Vice Chair Mazza had not been
  elected to serve as Chair during the Planning Commission reorganization on
  November 30, 2023. She informed the Commission she was glad that the skate park
  was approved.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION I STAFF COMMENTS

  Commissioner Smith welcomed his new grandchild Camilla Smith born earlier that
  day to the Smith family.

  Vice Chair Mazza congratulated Commissioner Smith on the birth of his
  granddaughter. Vice Chair Mazza stated that he found it extremely hard to be up to
  date on the current Planning Commission meeting given that the last Planning
  Commission was four days ago. He further expressed that he hoped this schedule
  would not occur again as it would be unfair to the applicants.

  Chair Hill mentioned the December 11, 2023 City Council continued hearing on
  the Accessory Dwelling Unit Ordinance. He asked the Commissioners to avoid
  speaking over one another to move hearings along and make deliberations clear for
  the record and reviewed the flow of hearings.

  The Planning Director provided an update on the upcoming winter holiday City
  Hall closure, December 22, 2023 through January 1, 2024. Services available via
  email and phone included Code Enforcement, Building Safety Inspections, Fire
  Rebuild Contract Planner and contract City reviewers. Services unavailable during
  the closure included communication with City staff, Building Safety and Planning
  Online Portals, the public counter, payment processing, and both Planning and
  Building Safety Hotlines (phone and email). He noted that the Malibu Municipal
  Code prohibited any construction on City holidays, which included Christmas and
  New Year’s Day. The update would be publicized via social media, at Planning
  Commission and City Council meetings and via outreach to applicants and owners
  of active projects.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  The following item was pulled, Item No. 3.B.I.

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.

ITEM 5  NEW PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  Coastal Development Permit No. 22-032, Variance Nos. 22-012. 22-013, 22-014,
  and 22-015, and Site Plan Review Nos. 22-019 and 22-020 An application for a
  —

  new single-family residence and associated development
  Location:  31532 ‘/2 Pacific Coast Highway, within the appealable coastal zone
  APN:  4470-009-059
  Owner:  Silvia Donahue, Trustee, Silvia Macedonio Donahue Living Trust
  Recommended Action: Adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-54
  determining the project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act, and approving Coastal Development Permit No. 22-032 to construct a
  new 3,913 square foot, two-story, single-family residence plus a 681 square foot
  attached three-car garage, 898 square foot attached second unit, spa, grading and
  retaining walls, and install landscaping, hardscape and onsite wastewater treatment
  system; including Variance No. 22-012 to develop on slopes steeper than 2.5 to 1,
  Variance No. 22-013 to extend fuel modification into Environmentally Sensitive
  Habitat Area, Variance No. 22-015 to construct transition slopes steeper than 2 to
  1, Variance No. 22-014 to reduce the side yard setback by 50 percent, Site Plan
  Review No. 22-019 to construct the residence in excess of 18 feet in height, up to
  24 feet with a flat roof, and Site Plan Review No. 22-020 to develop on slopes
  steeper than 3 to I and up to 2.5 to 1 located in the Rural Residential, Five-Acre
  zoning district at 31535 V2 Pacific Coast Highway (Silvia Macedonio Donahue
  Living Trust).

  Continued to the January 16, 2024 Regular Planning Commission meeting upon
  approval of the agenda.

  B.  Coastal Development Permit Amendment No. 22-008 An application to amend
  —

  Coastal Development Permit No. 16-028 to allow for the construction of a 999
  square foot basement addition to a previously approved 5.984 square foot. one-
  story single-family residence
  Location:  6333 Sea Star Drive, not within the appealable
  coastal zone
  APN:  4469-047-003
  Owner:  Issac Real Estate Holdings, Series LLC, Series A
  Recommended Action: Adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-55,
  determining the project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act, and approving Coastal Development Permit Amendment No. 22-008
  to amend Coastal Development Permit No. 16-0281 for the construction of a 999
  square foot basement addition to a previously approved 5,984 square foot, one
  story single-family residence and an expansion of the previously approved onsite
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes of December 4, 2023
  Page 5 of 8

  wastewater treatment system located in the Rural Residential, Two-Acres at 6333
  Sea Star Drive (Issac Real Estate Holdings, Series LLC, Series A).

  Disclosures: Commissioner Smith

  Staff report: Assistant Planner da Silva presented the staff report.

  Chair Hill opened the public comment portion of the hearing.

  Speakers: Susan Villain, Terry Winders, Jonathan Day

  As there were no other speakers present, Chair Hill closed the public comment
  portion of the hearing and returned the matter to the table for discussion,

  The Commission directed questions to the applicant team and staff.

MOTION  Vice Chair Mazza moved and Commissioner Peak seconded a motion to adopt
  Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-55, as amended, 1) adding Condition No.
  11 stating, “No rooftop decks of any kind are permitted on this structure or any
  future improvement of this structure.” and 2) determining the project is
  categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act, and
  approving Coastal Development Permit Amendment No. 22-008 to amend Coastal
  Development Permit No. 16-0281 for the construction of a 999 square foot
  basement addition to a previously approved 5,984 square foot, one-story single-
  family residence and an expansion of the previously approved onsite wastewater
  treatment system located in the Rural Residential, Two-Acres at 6333 Sea Star
  Drive (Issac Real Estate Holdings, Series LLC, Series A).

  The question was called and the motion carried unanimously.

  C.  Coastal Development Permit No. 23-015 An application for a new in-ground
  —

  pool and decking
  Location:  6316 Busch Drive. partially within the appealable coastal zone
  APN:  4467-029-005
  Owner:  Francoise and Jean-Pierre Hubschman, Trustees, Hubschman
  Family Trust dated May 12, 2016
  Recommended Action:
  1. Adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-58 determining the California
  Environmental Quality Act does not apply to the project, and denying Coastal
  Development Permit No. 23-015 for the construction of a new in-ground pool
  and decking located within 100 feet of mapped stream and wetland
  environmentally sensitive habitat area, in the Rural Residential, Two-Acres
  zoning district located at 6316 Busch Drive; or
  2. Determine that the project qualifies for a Coastal Development Permit
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes of December 4, 2023
  Page 6 of 8

  exemption, and direct staff to process the proposed development as an
  Administrative Plan Review.

  Disclosures: Smith, Peak, Leonard, Hill, Mazza

  Staff report: Senior Planner Brooks presented the staff report.

  Chair Hill opened the public comment portion of the hearing.

  Speakers: Don Schmitz, Ryan Embree, Jo Drummond

  As there were no other speakers present, Chair Hill closed the public comment
  portion of the hearing and returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  The Commission directed questions to the applicant team and staff.

MOTION  Vice Chair Mazza moved and Commissioner Peak seconded a motion to direct staff
  to bring the item back to the Planning Commission as Coastal Development Permit
  No. 23-015 on an expedited basis with the addition of a variance for development
  within the ESHA buffer and an approval letter from the California Department of
  Fish and Wildlife for the construction of a new in-ground pool and decking located
  within 100 feet of mapped stream and wetland environmentally sensitive habitat
  area, in the Rural Residential, Two-Acres zoning district located at 631 6 Busch
  Drive.

  The question was called and motion carried 4-1, Commissioner Smith dissenting.

  D.  Coastal Development Permit No. 22-057 An application for a new second unit
  —

  and onsite wastewater treatment system serving the second unit
  Location:  7058 Fernhill Drive, within the appealable coastal zone
  APN:  4466-010-019
  Owners:  Mastrippolito Trust
  Recommended Action: Adopt Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-57
  determining the project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act and approve Coastal Development Permit No. 22-057 to construct a
  new 891 square foot, maximum 18-foot tall, detached second unit with a new 285
  square foot attached garage, onsite wastewater treatment system to serve the second
  unit, and miscellaneous exterior site improvements located in the Rural Residential,
  One-Acre zoning district at 7058 Fernhill Drive (Mastrippolito Living Trust).

  Disclosures: Peak. Smith, Leonard, Hill, Mazza

  Staff report: Assistant Planner Allen presented the staff report.
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes of December 4, 2023
  Page 7 of 8

  Chair Hill opened the public comment portion of the hearing.

  Speaker: Dominic Mastrippolito

  As there were no other speakers present, Chair Hill closed the public comment
  portion of the hearing and returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  The Commission directed questions to the applicant team and staff.

  The Commission directed staff to request an update to project plans to reflect 891
  square feet rather than 900 square feet for the detached second unit.

MOTION  Commissioner Peak moved and Commissioner Smith seconded a motion to adopt
  Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-57 determining the project is
  categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act and approve
  Coastal Development Permit No. 22-057 to construct a new 891 square foot,
  maximum 1 8-foot tall, detached second unit with a new 285 square foot attached
  garage, onsite wastewater treatment system to serve the second unit, and
  miscellaneous exterior site improvements located in the Rural Residential, One-
  Acre zoning district at 7058 Fernhill Drive (Mastrippolito Living Trust).

FRIENDLY AMENDMENT
  Vice Chair Mazza requested an amendment to Section 3.A.2. to reflect that the
  Project is located between the sea and the first public road paralleling the sea.

  The Friendly Amendment was accepted by the maker and seconder.

FRIENDLY AMENDMENT
  Vice Chair Mazza requested an amendment to add a condition of approval requiring
  a determination by the Building Official on whether a demolition permit was
  required for removal of the sheds.

  The Friendly Amendment was accepted by the maker and seconder.

MOTION  Commissioner Peak moved and Commissioner Smith seconded a motion to adopt
  Planning Commission Resolution No. 23-57 as amended 1) modifying Section
  3.A.2. to state, “The Project is located between the sea and the first public road
  paralleling the sea. However, the project is in conformity with the public access and
  recreation policies of Chapter 3 of the Coastal Act of 1976.”; 2) adding Condition
  No. 55 stating, “The applicant shall contact the City Building Official to verify
  whether a demolition permit is required for removal of the sheds.”; and 3)
  determining the project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act and approve Coastal Development Permit No. 22-057 to construct a
  new 891 square foot, maximum 18-foot tall, detached second unit with a new 285
   Malibu Planning Commission

  square foot attached garage, onsite wastewater treatment system to serve the second
  unit, and miscellaneous exterior site improvements located in the Rural Residential,
  One-Acre zoning district at 7058 Fernhill Drive (Mastrippolito Living Trust).

  The question was called and the motion carried unanimously.
